login.title: ZhiMian HR Console
login.subtitle: Sign in with your HR email to manage your team's wellness pulse.
login.noteFooter: First time? Please contact sales to provision your enterprise account, then sign in with your HR email.
login.errNoHrRole: This email isn't yet authorized as HR. Contact ops at panxinglong-1@126.com to grant the role.
login.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Key team mental-health signals. Refreshed nightly.
overview.privacyFooter: This view aggregates {{period}} data from {{k}} employees. HR never sees individual conversation content or identity.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: {{n}} active employees in your company, grouped by team.
teams.empty: No teams yet. Add a 'team' column when uploading CSV — teams are created automatically.
teams.footerHint: Per-team drill-down view (separate report per team) is on the V2 roadmap. For now, filter by team in Reports.

employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Bulk-invite employees via CSV. We generate one-time invite codes and send invite emails.

csv.label: Employee roster CSV
csv.format: Columns supported: email (required), name (optional), team (optional, auto-created). BOM and bilingual headers are recognized.

employees.footerHint: If RESEND_API_KEY isn't configured, invite codes are generated but emails won't go out — share the codes with employees manually.

reports.title: Monthly report
reports.subtitle: Five-dimension detailed aggregated view.

crisis.noteAnonymous: This endpoint returns counts only. The system never exposes employee identity, conversation content, or raw event text to HR.

reports.pdfNote: PDF monthly report (5 sections + LLM insight + cover) lands in V2. For now, use browser print-to-PDF.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your enterprise profile and privacy guardrails.

privacy.title: Privacy guardrails
privacy.body: k-anonymity threshold defaults to 5 (we refuse to reveal numbers for groups smaller than 5). Contact ops to tighten to 10.

settings.footer: Profile editing, SSO integration, and renewals are planned for V2.

notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: Maybe a typo in the URL.
